title: Linearity of random restriction expectation
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\delta\in\mathbb R$, and let $\iota$ be a finite index set. For each $a\in\iota$, let $g_a$ assign a real value to every choice of a subset $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ and every sign assignment on the indices outside $J$. The sum over $a$ of the random restriction expectations of the functions $g_a$ equals the random restriction expectation of their pointwise sum.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is a family of real-valued functions on subsets and assignments to the complementary indices
